text: 20 minutes of hard thinking a day. After 10 to 20 hours, students focused *longer* and scored higher.

label: DRILL 1
head: Read 10 pages, then close the book
sub: Write 3 things you remember without looking.

label: DRILL 2
head: Write 3 pages with zero AI
sub: One question: why do I procrastinate?

label: DRILL 3
head: Solve problems one step above you
sub: Pen and paper. Show every step.

label: DRILL 4
head: Study 15 minutes, explain for 5
sub: Out loud, from memory, no notes.

head: *20 minutes* a day. Phone in another room.
